skill_name: Describe the structure and function of an N-Gram language model.
workflow: An N-Gram language model is a probabilistic model that takes as input a sequence of N items and tries to predict the probability of the next item in the sequence. The structure of a N-Gram model consists of a set of N-grams, which are tuples of N items, with each item typically being a word. The N-grams are used to calculate the probability of the next word in the sequence, by taking into account the context in which it appears.
